humanAction: Ran "Rollover Daily Todos: Rollover Todos Now" from the command palette with the core daily-notes folder pointed at Daily/, format YYYY-MM-DD, no template. Unfinished todos moved out of Daily/2026-09-08.md into Daily/2026-09-09.md under the "## Todos" heading; the finished todo stayed behind.
notes: DATE-DEPENDENT: the capture ran on 2026-09-09, so Daily/2026-09-09.md is "today" and Daily/2026-09-08.md is the previous daily note. A replay must either pin the clock to 2026-09-09 or shift both fixture file names to the replay date. HOST PRECONDITION: the core daily-notes plugin must be enabled with options {folder: "Daily", format: "YYYY-MM-DD", template: ""}; the plugin reads them through getDailyNoteSettings on every call. Calling rollover(file) with an explicit file is refused unless the file was created within the plugin's MAX_TIME_SINCE_CREATION window, so the command path (file undefined, which sets ignoreCreationTime) is the only reliable entry point. deleteOnComplete is true, which is why the rolled-over todos are removed from the previous day's note. The plugin is not enabled in the capture vault; it was loaded at runtime with enablePlugin (never enablePluginAndSave), guarded so it could only see the scratch daily notes, and unloaded again.
